newsitem.title: USA: Productivity Tech unit gets $14.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Productivity Tech unit gets $14.5 million.

text.p: Productivity Technologies Corp said Wednesday an operating subsidiary had closed a new committed revolving line of credit for $14.5 million and received approval for a $4.5-million Industrial Revenue Bond (IRB).

It said the subsidiary, Atlas Technologies, will use the IRB to finance the construction of a 59,000-square-foot plant in Fenton, Michigan. The plant will expand its capacity by about 80 percent, it said.
Productivity Technologies Corp is a manufacturer of automation equipment for large press lines and other manufacturing processes.
